title: Generic M4RI Wasm declaration lowering
objective: Enable the declared M4RI resources and operations for generic Wasm lowering, including explicitly selected scalar capability operations and real reactor lifecycle coverage.

handoff.summary: Declared the complete M4RI resource API for Wasm, generalized the CoWasm adapter builder for library-specific dependency stacks, admitted explicitly selected scalar capability operations, and verified all operations against the real libm4ri reactor with deterministic cleanup.
risks: CoWasm currently provides M4RI 20250128 while native Sage.js pins 20260122; the exercised ABI is compatible, but distribution should converge the pins.
The full portable tier has inherited failures in this worktree: absent restored FLINT addon and 21 unverified website reference records.
next_steps: Integrate the dependent browser distribution lane and run its real Chromium public lifecycle test.
